notes: 0.125" 316, SendCutSend, mill finish 2B, add deburring. Thickness tolerance +.001"/-.010" — the tight positive half is what keeps a max-thickness plate seating between the tee wall's fore face and the slot's own, and the negative half is `enclosure_assembly.PLATE_T_UNDER`, which the release stroke carries as lost motion. Tumbling is unavailable: max tumble part is 4" x 7" and this plate is 7.705" long. Deburring is available (min 1" x 3") and is bought — the four holes pass LLDPE tube on every pump service, and assembly runs a bare finger down the seated top edge.
